transcript.content: Hello, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

I've been hearing voices and seeing things that other people tell me aren't actually there, and it's been happening for about a year now. I'm just really confused and scared because it all feels so real to me.

During the times you hear or see things, have you also had long periods of feeling extremely depressed or unusually energized with little need for sleep? Or do the voices and visions happen even when your mood feels normal?
No, I haven't really experienced those extreme highs or lows. The voices and visions seem to happen even when my mood is completely normal.
Over this past year, have these experiences made it hard for you to work, study, or take care of yourself? Or aside from the voices and visions, have you been functioning pretty normally?
I'm not really sure, to be honest. I haven't really thought about how it affects my daily routine or work because I'm just so distracted by the voices and the things I see.

Besides the voices and visions, do you have fixed beliefs that others say aren’t true, like being followed or having special powers? Or is it mainly the hearing and seeing things that’s been happening?

No, I don't have any beliefs like that, and I've never felt like I was being followed or had special powers. It really is just the hearing and seeing things that has been happening to me. Those are the main things that have been going on this whole year.
Over this past year, have you noticed things like losing motivation, speaking less, feeling emotionally flat, or pulling away from other people? Or has it mainly just been the voices and visions?
No, I haven't really noticed losing motivation, speaking less, or feeling emotionally flat. It has really just been the voices and the visions that I've been dealing with this past year.
Have you had times when your thoughts or speech felt jumbled, or other people had trouble following what you were saying? And have you ever acted in a very disorganized or unusual way?

Yes, for about a year now, people have really struggled to understand me because my thoughts jump around rapidly and I easily drift off-topic. Sometimes I even use strange words or rhymes that only make sense to me, making my speech feel very jumbled. I don't think I've acted in an unusual way, though.

Have you ever had a period lasting several days when you felt unusually energized or euphoric, needed much less sleep, talked more than usual, and did risky or impulsive things? If so, did that happen around the same time as the voices or seeing things?
No, I've never had periods where I felt unusually energized, euphoric, or needed less sleep. I haven't done any risky or impulsive things either. I really haven't felt that way at all.
